allOf.description: Complete editable calendar settings. name and sortKey are required. Omitted color, campusId, eventTemplateId, iCalSourceUrl and evTermineEventTypeId are cleared; syncToEvTermine defaults to false. The calendar type cannot be changed here. Supplying a non-empty iCalSourceUrl triggers replacement/import of calendar contents, including when saving other settings with the same source URL.

campusId.description: Campus associated with this calendar, or null for no campus. A campus represents a ChurchTools location/site, not a calendar permission group.

color.description: Display color, normally a CSS hex color such as #336699. Omission clears the color; the backend checks only the text length.

evTermineEventTypeId.description: Event type ID used by the Evangelische Termine integration, or null. This is an external event classification, not a ChurchTools calendar type.

eventTemplateId.description: Configured service-planning event template ID for this calendar, or null. This differs from an appointment template.

iCalSourceUrl.description: External iCalendar feed to import, or null for a locally managed calendar. webcal:// and ical:// are normalized to https://; addresses without a scheme receive https://. Saving a non-empty source URL clears existing calendar contents before importing the feed, even when the URL is unchanged. Import and URL errors cause the request to fail.

name.description: Calendar display name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

sortKey.description: Display order. The calendar list is sorted by this value in ascending order.

syncToEvTermine.description: Whether the Evangelische Termine integration should synchronize this calendar. This is separate from importing an iCalendar feed.

type.description: Calendar category used by ChurchTools: church for a church calendar, group for a group calendar, personal for a personal calendar. The category determines which administration permissions apply; it does not by itself grant public access or link the calendar to a particular group or person. Access is controlled separately. The type is chosen on creation and cannot be changed by PUT.

schema.description: Create a calendar with its category and settings. The creator receives permission to edit its appointments. Calendar creation does not itself create appointments, except when an iCalSourceUrl initiates a feed import.

post.description: Creates a person using only fields the current user may write. Before calling this endpoint, retrieve valid `statusId`, `campusId`, and `departmentIds` values from `GET /person/masterdata`. Read `GET /config` to determine whether `privacy_policy_fields_mandatory` is enabled. If it is enabled, provide all three privacy agreement fields. `privacyPolicyAgreementTypeId` describes how the agreement was obtained, while `privacyPolicyAgreementWhoId` describes who gave it; these are independent facts and must not be inferred from each other. The `without_privacy_policy_agreement` parameter is only effective when `privacy_policy_fields_mandatory_api` is disabled and must not be used without first verifying that setting. If a duplicate person is found, repeat the request with `force` only after intentionally deciding to create the duplicate.

parameters.description: Omits the otherwise mandatory privacy policy agreement fields. Only effective when `privacy_policy_fields_mandatory_api` is disabled in the ChurchTools configuration.
